# Recon: code map — zai-quota-statusline v0.1.22 (`/workspace/zai-quota-statusline`)

White-box recon + full data-flow map. Builds on the shared threat model (B1 stdin/session JSON, B2 Z.AI API, B3 update path, B4 `~/.claude/zaiquota` cache dir). All paths relative to repo root unless noted. **Candidates listed at the end are HYPOTHESES for validation — nothing here is a confirmed finding.**

## Deployment shape (confirmed from code + README)

- Plugin hooks fire on SessionStart/UserPromptSubmit/Stop (`hooks/hooks.json:4-44`). Pattern: `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/sync.sh` (or `ensure-current.sh`) then execute `${ZAI_QUOTA_DIR:-${CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR:-$HOME/.claude}/zaiquota}/quota-hook.sh <event>` (hooks.json:14,26,38). **Hook executors run the copy of the script that lives in the B4 dir**, after syncing from the plugin root.
- Statusline itself is NOT registered by the plugin (README:100 "plugins can't"); the user adds `bash $HOME/.claude/zaiquota/zai-statusline.sh` to `~/.claude/settings.json` (README:107,154,257) → runs at 1 Hz with session JSON on stdin.
- `commands/refresh.md:3,6` — slash command runs `bash ${...}/quota-fetch.sh --force` via `allowed-tools`.

## 1. Data-flow map, script by script

### scripts/zai-statusline.sh (366 LoC; entrypoint: Claude Code pipes session JSON to stdin, 1 Hz)

Untrusted sources:
- B1 stdin session JSON: `IN=$(cat)` :14. Extracted fields via `jq -r`: `.model.display_name//.model.id` :75-76, `.session_id` :205, `.context_window.used_percentage` :317, `.cost.total_cost_usd` :332, `.context_window.current_usage.{input,cache_read_input_tokens,output_tokens}` :304.
- B4 cache file `$CACHE` (= `$DIR/quota.cache`): read :93-119 (`jq -r ... @tsv` → `IFS=$'\t' read -r h5p h5r wp wr fetched src`), fields then `num`-sanitized :122, `src` whitelisted :123. State file `$DIR/.ctx[-sid]` :271 (`IFS='|' read -r S C N T`), sanitized :272. Stamp `$DIR/.rollrefresh` first line :163 (`num`-sanitized :164). Turn flags `$DIR/.turn[-sid]` first line :209 (`num`-sanitized inline).
- Env vars: `ZAI_QUOTA_DIR`/`CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` :15, `ZAI_SB_CACHE` :16, `ZAI_SB_SEGMENTS` :17, `ZAI_SB_AGE` :18, `ZAI_ROLL_MIN` :138, `ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN` :195, `ZAI_SB_CTX_JUMP` :267, `ZAI_SB_DEBUG` :300, `ZAI_SB_TEST_TICK` :354, `ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_{OPUS,SONNET,HAIKU}_MODEL` :68 via `tier_model` (also reads `$HOME/.claude/settings.json` / `settings.local.json` `.env[$k]` :69-71 — B1-adjacent: those files can contain model names set by any local writer).

Sinks:
- Shell arithmetic on cache-derived values: `$(( now - last ))` :164, `[ "$h5r" -gt 0 ]` etc :179-180, :196, :209, :235, :245, :249, `ctx_hyst` :275-287, `$(( 100 - V ))` :322, `bar()` :223-224 — inputs pass through `num()` (:44-46, `[!0-9]*` guard) first, and bash `-gt`/`$(( ))` do NOT re-expand `$( )`/backticks (verified empirically: `$(printf CALC_RAN)` inside `$(( ))` is a syntax error, not execution). Residual risk = unhandled `bash: syntax error` killing the render, not exec.
- Terminal output (B1/B4 → user's terminal): `model` printed into chip :361-364 — sanitized :86-89 (sed strips `ESC [ ... letter`, `tr -d [:cntrl:]`, cut 40 chars; NOT single-quoted-string-safe but terminal-safe for SGR/C0; note sed pattern `s/\033\[[0-9;]*[A-Za-z]//g` handles CSI but not e.g. OSC `ESC ]...BEL` — partially covered by cntrl strip, which deletes the ESC byte itself, de-fanging OSC). `cost` :332-342 — constrained to `LC_NUMERIC=C printf '%.2f'` output :337 (non-numeric → empty :334,337). Quota/statusline printf compositions :243-253 — only `num`-sanitized ints enter.
- Terminal-renderable LOG files (not the statusline): `statusline-debug.log` write :305-308 (gated on `ZAI_SB_DEBUG=1` :300) includes `io` = `@tsv` output of stdin token counts — @tsv escapes `\ \t \n \r` (jqsh:410-411) but NOT other C0/C1 bytes (e.g. ESC) → **raw stdin JSON bytes can reach the log; `README:228` tells users to `tail -n 20 hook.log`**.
- File writes: `.ctx[-sid]` via `$st.$$` + `mv -f` :291-296 (path prefix trusted, sid sanitized :206); stamp `.rollrefresh` :165; locks `.rollrefresh.lock` symlink :145-152,159,171 (target = own PID only).
- Subprocess spawn: background `( ... quota-hook.sh session </dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1 & )` :169 — path from own dirname, argv constant.

### scripts/quota-fetch.sh (133 LoC; entrypoints: hook wrapper :117/:121 of quota-hook.sh, `/refresh` command, manual)

Untrusted sources:
- Env/config: `ZAI_QUOTA_DIR`/`CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` :29, `ZAI_REFRESH_MIN` :31, `ZAI_FETCH_CURL_TIMEOUT` :95, `ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN` :56, `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` :57 (env wins; fallback = `cfg` grep-parse of `$DIR/config.env` :38-48 — parsed, never sourced; ownership+regular-file check :50-53, chmod 600 self-heal :54).
- **B2 HTTPS response**: `curl -sS -o "$tmp" -w '%{http_code}' --max-time ... -H "Authorization: ${ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN}" ... "$url"` :94-99. Body only to `$tmp`; on non-200 `head -c 2000 "$tmp" >&2` :103 (→ stderr → hook.log via quota-hook :117/:121); shape validation `.data.limits` array :110, non-empty :123; cached via `jq -c --argjson ts "$(date +%s)" '{fetched_at:$ts, data:.data}' "$tmp" > "$out"` :129 then atomic `mv -f "$out" "$CACHE"` :130. **Unsanitized `.data` is cached verbatim** — downstream consumers: statusline quota parse + any jq consumer.
- Cache file (B4) read for throttle: `.fetched_at` :64 (used in `[ $(( now - last )) -lt "$MIN_INTERVAL" ]` :66 — non-numeric → bash error; `|| echo 0` :64 catches jq failure but not "123abc" → arithmetic error → `set -e` exit; harmless stale-fetch, no exec).

Sinks: curl argv :94-99 (URL built :82-88 from `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` — see B2 below; token in `Authorization` header); temp files `mktemp "$DIR/.fetch.XXXXXX"` :91-92 (same dir as cache, trap cleanup :93); cache replace :130; error output to stderr :51,73,77,86,99,102-103,111-112,124 (body excerpt :103,:112 → hook.log).

### scripts/quota-hook.sh (126 LoC; entrypoints: hooks.json session/pre/post; `session` also spawned by statusline:169)

Untrusted sources:
- B1 hook stdin: `req=$(cat 2>/dev/null || true)` :37; `sid=$(jq -r '.session_id // empty' <<<"$req")` :52, sanitized to `[A-Za-z0-9_-]*` :53 → used in path `"$DIR/.turn${sid:+-$sid}"` :54-56 (write `printf '%s\n' "$now" >"$TURN"` :56, `rm -f` :57).
- B4 sweep: session event globs `"$DIR"/.turn* "$DIR"/.ctx*` :59, reads first fields :61-63, `rm -f` on age > 86400 :64 (deletes only files matching `.turn*`/`.ctx*` glob in trusted dir; timestamps `num`-guarded :63).
- Env: `ZAI_QUOTA_DIR`/`CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` :25, `ZAI_HOOK_DEDUP_SEC` :35 (used in `[ "$age" -lt "$WINDOW" ]` :98 — non-numeric → bash test error → with `set -u` only, script continues; no exec), `ZAI_HOOK_FETCH_TIMEOUT` :117.
- B4 state file `.hook-state` :94 (`IFS='|' read -r last src`; `last` into `$(( now - last ))` :95 — malformed → arithmetic error; `src` compared literally :100, logged :107).

Sinks: file writes `.turn[-sid]` :56-57, `.hook-state` :111 (`echo "$now|$EV"` — constant fields), `hook.log` appends :81,88,107,112,125 (constant/date strings only — no untrusted interpolation); lock `$DIR/.fetch.lock` symlink :87,86 `rm -rf "$LOCK"` (fixed name); child exec `timeout "${ZAI_HOOK_FETCH_TIMEOUT:-15}" "$SCRIPT_DIR/quota-fetch.sh" --force >>"$LOG" 2>&1` :117 / plain :121 — quota-fetch stderr (incl. B2 body excerpt, fetch.sh:103,112) is captured into hook.log.

### scripts/sync.sh (23 LoC; entrypoint: hooks.json SessionStart :9,14; ensure-current.sh :38)

Reads `$SRC/*.sh` + `$SRC/jqsh` :16 (`SRC` = own dir :11); writes `$DEST/.sync.$name.$$` :19-20 then `chmod 755` :21 and `mv -f` into `$DEST/$name` :22. `DEST` = `$ZAI_QUOTA_DIR|...` :10 — **executable scripts are installed into a user-writable dir**; no integrity check (by design, `set -eu`).

### scripts/ensure-current.sh (50 LoC; entrypoint: hooks.json UserPromptSubmit :26 / Stop :38)

Reads `$SRC/*.sh`+jqsh :29-32 (`cmp -s` vs `$DEST/$name` :32), runs `"$SRC/sync.sh"` :38, appends to `$DEST/hook.log` :39,47 (orphan names from `basename` of `$DEST/*.sh` :43-47 — filename bytes from B4 dir land in hook.log; no control-char filter, but filenames come from the sync-set or user-created files). No network, no remote fetch. Best-effort, always exit 0 :49.

### scripts/jqsh (647 LoC Python; entrypoint: shell fallback `jq()` in all three bash scripts — statusline:22-23, fetch:26-27, hook:28-29)

- CLI flags exercised by callers: `-r`, `-c` (fetch:129), `-e` (fetch:110,123), `--arg` (statusline:71), `--argjson` (fetch:129). Supported-but-unused: `--version`, `--raw-output`, `--compact-output`, `--exit-status`; unknown flag → usage error :599-601.
- Input: filter string from **caller-fixed literals only** (all filters in repo are constants; no untrusted filter construction found); JSON text from file (argv, `open(files[0])` :616) or stdin :616 — the untrusted input is the JSON document only.
- **No eval/exec/compile/system/import sinks** — verified by AST pass (`ast-python-map.txt`): only `re.compile` of fixed patterns :31 and the single `open(files[0])` :616. It is a pure tree-walking interpreter (lexical structure fixed, data untrusted).
- Resource limits: RecursionError caught only in eval loop :636-638 (`filter too deep`); **parser recursion is NOT caught** (deeply nested `((((...` in a caller-fixed filter → traceback; filters are constants, so only data-driven). No output-size/time caps; result multiplication via cartesian products (:476-477,488-489) and nested iteration scales with data size. Python arbitrary-precision ints from `json.loads` — no overflow path. Lone `\uXXXX` surrogates in `unescape` :77 can crash emit with UnicodeEncodeError (unhandled → non-zero exit → callers' "parser failed" fallback).
- Output contract: `-r` prints strings raw :561-562; `@tsv` escapes `\ \t \n \r` only :410-411.

## 2. Trust-boundary confirmations

- **B2 (CONFIRMED)**: `quota-fetch.sh:82` extracts `${scheme}://host[:port]` from `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` via `sed -E 's|(https?://[^/]+).*|\1|'`; :83-87 requires `https://` (loopback http allowed); `:88` appends fixed path → `url="${domain}/api/monitor/usage/quota/limit"`. README:88 default config = `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL=https://api.z.ai/api/anthropic` → effective endpoint `https://api.z.ai/api/monitor/usage/quota/limit`. API key passed raw as `-H "Authorization: ${ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN}"` :96 (no Bearer prefix). Storage: env var (precedence, :56-57) or `$DIR/config.env` plain `KEY=VALUE` grep-parse :38-48 (chmod 600 self-heal :54). Token never appears in logs/errors in normal flow (curl `-sS` errors don't echo headers).
- **B3 (CONFIRMED — no remote update path in-repo)**: `sync.sh` copies LOCAL plugin files into the stable dir (:16-22); `ensure-current.sh` only `cmp`s local files and re-runs local `sync.sh` (:29-38). **No curl/wget/git/network call, no checksum/signature verification, no remote version metadata anywhere outside quota-fetch.sh's single Z.AI GET.** Residual B3 risk is (a) plugin distribution itself (marketplace JSON, version 0.1.22, no pinning) and (b) CI: semgrep flagged mutable action-tag refs in `.github/workflows/ci.yml:12`, `release.yml:14,37` and missing dependabot cooldown (`.github/dependabot.yml:3`) — supply-chain hygiene, not runtime code.

## 3. Attack-surface enumeration

Env vars read: `ZAI_QUOTA_DIR`, `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR`, `ZAI_SB_CACHE`, `ZAI_SB_SEGMENTS`, `ZAI_SB_AGE`, `ZAI_ROLL_MIN`, `ZAI_SB_CTX_JUMP`, `ZAI_SB_DEBUG`, `ZAI_SB_TEST_TICK`, `ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_OPUS_MODEL`, `ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_SONNET_MODEL`, `ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_HAIKU_MODEL`, `ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN`, `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL`, `ZAI_REFRESH_MIN`, `ZAI_FETCH_CURL_TIMEOUT`, `ZAI_HOOK_DEDUP_SEC`, `ZAI_HOOK_FETCH_TIMEOUT`, `HOME` (locations cited in §1). hooks.json expands `CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT` (:9,14,26,38).

Files read: stdin session/hook JSON (statusline:14, hook:37); `$DIR/quota.cache` (statusline:93-119, fetch:63-64); `$DIR/config.env` (fetch:37-56); `~/.claude/settings.json`, `~/.claude/settings.local.json` (statusline:69-71); `$DIR/.rollrefresh` + `.lock` (statusline:140-165); `$DIR/.fetch.lock` (statusline:156-157, hook:75-79); `$DIR/.turn*`, `$DIR/.ctx*` (statusline:207-209,271; hook:59-64); `$DIR/.hook-state` (hook:94); `$DIR/hook.log`, `$DIR/statusline-debug.log` (rotation reads, hook:42, statusline:302); `$SRC/*.sh`,`$SRC/jqsh` (sync:16, ensure:29-32).

Files written: `quota.cache` (fetch:129-130 via `.fetch.XXXXXX`); `.fetch.XXXXXX` temps (fetch:91-92); `.turn[-sid]` (hook:56-57); `.hook-state` (hook:111); `.rollrefresh` (statusline:165) + `.rollrefresh.lock` symlink (statusline:152); `.fetch.lock` symlink (hook:87); `.ctx[-sid]` via `.ctx.$$` (statusline:291-296); `hook.log` (hook:81,88,107,112,125; ensure:39,47); `statusline-debug.log` (statusline:305-308); `$DEST/*.sh`,`$DEST/jqsh` executables (sync:19-22); `config.env` chmod (fetch:54); sweep `rm -f` of `.turn*`/`.ctx*` (hook:64).

Subprocesses: `python3 jqsh` (statusline:23, fetch:27, hook:29), `curl` (fetch:94), `grep` (fetch:40), `timeout` (hook:117), `quota-fetch.sh --force` (hook:117,121), `quota-hook.sh session` (statusline:169), `sync.sh` (ensure:38), plus coreutils: sed, tr, cut, date, head, wc, cat, readlink, kill, rm, ln, mktemp, mv, cp, chmod, cmp, basename, dirname, pwd, `command -v`.

jqsh CLI flags exercised: `-r`, `-c`, `-e`, `--arg`, `--argjson` (all filters are in-repo constant literals).

## 4. Static triage bundle (`/workspace/.source-aware/`)

- `semgrep.json` (p/default+p/golang+p/secrets, 334 rules / 25 files): **4 hits, all CI-config**: dependabot-missing-cooldown (.github/dependabot.yml:3, MEDIUM), github-actions-mutable-action-tag (ci.yml:12; release.yml:14,37 — WARNINGs). Zero hits in `scripts/` — no rule matches for shell eval/command-injection/secret patterns in product code.
- `sg-targets.txt` (25 files, built from semgrep `paths.scanned`) + `ast-grep.json`: the generic `$F($$$ARGS)` xargs pass ran but produced 0 bytes — this sandbox's ast-grep 0.45.0 (`~/.npm-global/bin/sg`) returns exit 0 with empty output for any pattern on paths under this repo while the same pattern works on `/tmp` targets (environment quirk, logged in `ast-grep*.log`). Compensating structural passes actually collected: language-scoped sink patterns (`eval($$$A)`, `curl $$$A`, `$F($$$A)` etc. on scripts/*.sh) — `eval` 0 hits, `curl` 1 (fetch:94), plus `ast-python-map.txt` (full Python `ast` map of jqsh: 355 lines — function defs, every call site, security-relevant sink check). **Caveat for the record: the mandated xargs-sg artifact is empty; AST coverage was delivered via scoped sg runs + Python ast.** `tree-sitter parse` unavailable (no grammars installed).
- `gitleaks.json` + `trufflehog.json` (38 commits, ~200 KB scanned): **no leaks found**, both empty.
- `trivy-fs.json`: 701 bytes — no vulnerable dependencies (no lockfiles/manifests), no misconfig findings.
- `scripts/__pycache__/jqshcpython-310.pyc` is committed but inert (jqsh is executed as a script, never imported).

## 5. Prioritized validation candidates — HYPOTHESES, mapping only (no report, no exploit)

| # | Candidate | Untrusted source → sink (file:line) | Boundary | Why plausible |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| H1 | Terminal escape injection via `model.display_name` on non-jqsh fallback | stdin JSON :75 → chip printf :361-364; sanitizer :86-89 strips CSI + `[:cntrl:]` (kills ESC) — looks solid; needs validation of `sed -E $'s/\033...'` behavior on GNU vs BSD (macOS!) and of multi-byte/C1 (0x80-0x9F as UTF-8 tail) sequences | B1 | One exact sed flavor failing on macOS (the README's own rationale for avoiding `sed I`) would pass raw bytes to the terminal |
| H2 | Terminal escape/CSV confusion via `@tsv` + log tail: ESC bytes pass through `@tsv` into `statusline-debug.log` (statusline:304-308) and B2 error bodies into `hook.log` (fetch:103,112 → hook:117,121); README:228 tells users to `tail hook.log` | B1/B2/B4 | Any C0/C1 except \t\n\r\\ survives `@tsv` and the raw body `head -c 2000`; tail renders it in a terminal |
| H3 | Cache-field arithmetic DoS/oddity: tampered `quota.cache` (B4) with e.g. `fetched_at="123abc"` breaks `[ $(( now - last )) ...` (fetch:66 with `set -euo pipefail` → exit; statusline:164/179/209 → nudge logic skew) despite `num()` on the statusline side | B4 | `fetch:64`'s `|| echo 0` only catches jq failure, not numeric-junk output from a tampered cache |
| H4 | `.session_id` is `[A-Za-z0-9_-]`-whitelisted before path use (hook:53, statusline:206) — validate whether any bypass (jqsh `-r` raw output of e.g. number/string concatenation, or real-jq differences) yields path-shaping input | B1 | Whitelist looks correct; candidate exists only to confirm no `-r`-edge (e.g. value `123e4`) slips through |
| H5 | `settings.json` `.env` model mapping (statusline:69-71) — values flow to chip through the :86-89 sanitizer; validate that a hostile `ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_SONNET_MODEL` (settings file or env) can't smuggle sequences the sanitizer misses (same class as H1, second entrypoint) | B1/local | Second untrusted producer feeding the same sink |
| H6 | `quota-hook.sh` state/sweep files: malformed `.hook-state` (`last`) → `$(( now - last ))` arithmetic error (hook:95) under `set -u` (no -e) — confirm no partial-state corruption; `.turn*` sweep `rm -f` (hook:64) — confirm glob can't be widened (symlinked dirs?) | B4 | Local-tamper class; impact likely DoS-only |
| H7 | jqsh robustness under B2-controlled data: deep nesting/lone surrogates/huge ints from a hostile API body → unhandled exceptions (:623-627 JSON parse covered; emit-time UnicodeEncodeError and parser RecursionError NOT caught) → error paths in callers; confirm failure is fail-safe (statusline "quota n/a", fetch refuses cache write) | B2 | Explicit invariant in threat model: "jqsh must parse untrusted JSON without code execution or unbounded resource use" |
| H8 | `ensure-current.sh:43-47` writes `$name` (basename of B4 files) into `hook.log` unfiltered — filename with ESC/newline → log-spoofing/tail injection (needs arbitrary local write first) | B4 | Low prior; chained-tamper class |
| H9 | `cfg` grep parsing of `config.env` (fetch:38-48): `grep -E "^$1="` with `$1` always literal from callers (safe today) — validate no regex-injection future-proofing issue; also quoted-value strip only handles outer quotes (`"VA"L"` survives) — could a crafted config.env value change curl argv semantics? (token goes into `-H "Authorization: ..."` quoted — newline in token would split the header) | local config | Newline-bearing `ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN` from env/config reaches curl header unvalidated (fetch:56,96) |
| H10 | `ZAI_FETCH_CURL_TIMEOUT` / `ZAI_HOOK_FETCH_TIMEOUT` / `ZAI_REFRESH_MIN` / `ZAI_HOOK_DEDUP_SEC` reach `--max-time` (fetch:95), `timeout` argv (hook:117) and tests (:31,66,98) unvalidated — non-numeric/junk values → argparse/arith errors; confirm pure DoS-of-self, no argv injection via `timeout` | local env | `timeout "$VAR" cmd` is argv-safe by construction; listed to close the class |

Negative/control notes already established during mapping (for validators): bash arithmetic `$(( ))` and `[ -gt/-lt ]` do NOT perform command substitution on their operands (empirically verified this run) — so H3/H6 are DoS-class, not exec; `hooks.json` commands are fully quoted paths with env-expansion done by Claude Code, not by an intermediate shell script; `jqsh` has no code-exec sink (AST-verified).

Static artifacts: `/workspace/.source-aware/{semgrep.json, sg-targets.txt, ast-grep*.json|log, ast-python-map.txt, gitleaks.json, trufflehog.json, trufflehog.err, trivy-fs.json}`.
